_about: Upgrade (craft) success chances (the owner, 2026-11-08: "right now the combining modification changes drop too fast 100% on the same level, 50 and 25% for levels lower", "it should be 100, 95, 90"). gameplay/items/craft/craft.options, read only by the server (items_rules::craft, 0x9B to the lobby's upgrade window): craft_probabilities_<general|premium>[d] = [success %, failure %] for an item with d = 0, 1, 2 more modifications than its donor. Success 100/95/90 in both tables (premium was 100/50/25, general 50/25/12.5), so silver and gold crafts agree whichever the server reads. Failure 0 everywhere: srp never takes a modification away (the owner's rule of 2026-10-23, docs/notes/craft-menu.md) and 0x9B already sends it as 0; without it the rows' success and failure would add up past 100.
